0.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_000
0.description: In need of information about this or that? Pray do not hesitate to ask. This island offers many unique challenges, and it would behoove you to approach them in a logical and reasoned fashion.

2.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_A1_000_001
2.description: This island and its unique challenges.

15.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_010
15.description: Before I continue, I feel compelled to stress that this is not the Eureka of legend─that is to say, a subterranean labyrinth containing ancient Allag's most terrible weapons. I would think that evident from the fact that we are on an island and outside, but some people are surprisingly daft...

16.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_011
16.description: The Forbidden Land, Eureka, is a mysterious and deadly island where the elemental forces are constantly in flux. It may be explored in parties of up to eight players, or solo.

17.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_012
17.description: Adventurers who choose to brave the wilds of Eureka will find that their strength there is measured in their <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>elemental level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

18.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_100_012
18.description: Moreover, all equipped items will be subject to item level sync.

19.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_013
19.description: Unlike instanced duties, a given region within Eureka may be occupied by up to 144 players, with whom you may choose to cooperate if you so desire!

20.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_020
20.description: The very elements are an enemy in Eureka, I fear. When braving these wilds, you must pay close attention to the fluctuations and alter your stratagems as necessary.

21.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_021
21.description: Your strength in Eureka is measured in your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>elemental level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which may be increased by defeating various enemies and gaining <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>elemental experience points<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

22.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_022
22.description: Your level and EXP accrued will be retained between visits─progress will not be lost when you depart Eureka.

23.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_023
23.description: Please be advised that elemental EXP gained may be affected by the number of players in your party and the difficulty of the enemies you defeat.

24.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_030
24.description: Aside from the very real risk of death, should you fall in battle with one of the denizens of Eureka, the consequences may be more grievous than you expect.

25.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_031
25.description: When you are KO'd in the Forbidden Land, Eureka, you will lose elemental EXP.

26.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_032
26.description: However, if you are revived by another player within ten minutes of being KO'd, you will receive no elemental EXP penalty.

27.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_033
27.description: Furthermore, if your current elemental level is five or below, you will not lose elemental EXP when KO'd.

28.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_034
28.description: Please be advised that, if your elemental level is eleven or higher, this penalty may reduce your elemental EXP total below zero. Should this happen, you will lose an elemental level.

29.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_040
29.description: The warped aetheric currents of this island have in turn warped its inhabitants. While they are more dangerous for it, a wary adventurer may find a way to turn their strengths into weaknesses.

30.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_041
30.description: Enemies encountered in the Forbidden Land, Eureka, are imbued with powers aspected to a particular element.

31.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_042
31.description: This elemental aspect is indicated by an icon to the left of their <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>display names<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. When engaging an enemy in battle, it may be prudent to alter your tactics accordingly.

32.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_050
32.description: Beasts described as such are not unique to Eureka. As is the case with their counterparts elsewhere, you will want to enlist the support of others, as hunting them on your own is ill-advised.

33.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_051
33.description: In the Forbidden Land, Eureka, you may encounter especially powerful enemies called notorious monsters. You would do well to engage these enemies together with other adventurers if you wish to defeat them.

34.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_100_051
34.description: Some notorious monsters will not appear unless certain conditions are met. Speak with other adventurers and share information that you might determine what these conditions are.

35.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_060
35.description: Though the laws of nature have been twisted in Eureka, one maxim remains true: with great risk comes great reward. In particular, there is a type of crystal which we have been instructed to seek out at all costs...

36.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_061
36.description: When you defeat enemies in battle, you may receive a variety of rewards. Among these possible rewards are <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>protean crystals<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which may be used to strengthen and enhance Eureka gear.

37.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_070
37.description: Adventurers are rather fond of their phrases, are they not? I believe what you describe is akin to when one descends into a killing frenzy or some such...

38.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_071
38.description: Upon defeating an enemy, you will have a limited window in which you may attempt to defeat another. If successful, you will initiate an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>EXP chain<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

39.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_072
39.description: Defeating subsequent enemies while an EXP chain is active will earn you additional elemental EXP. You will also have an increased chance to receive rewards, as well as higher quantities of said rewards.

40.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_080
40.description: Well, that is just common sense, I would like to think. There are limits to what even an experienced adventurer like you can accomplish, so if you seek to take on even greater challenges, why not join with others in order to do so?

41.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_081
41.description: Unlike in instanced duties, in the Forbidden Land, Eureka, you may form and leave parties with other players at will.

42.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_082
42.description: You may also use the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Adventurer List<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to seek out players close in elemental level to form parties and explore Eureka together.

44.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_A3_000_001
44.description: Basic usage of the magia board.

48.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_090
48.description: The magia board is a simple, elegant device created by Miss Krile and Gerolt to aid adventurers in their exploration of Eureka...

49.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_091
49.description: The <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>magia board<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be used in conjunction with <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>magicite<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to strengthen your affinity with the six elements while exploring the Forbidden Land, Eureka.

50.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_092
50.description: Stronger affinity with a given element will increase the damage you deal certain enemies, as well as reduce the damage you receive from others.

51.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_093
51.description: You may configure your magia board by affixing or removing magicite with the use of a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>magia melder<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which can be found in Port Surgate and other encampments.

52.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_100
52.description: Miss Krile and Gerolt wisely understood that no amount of preparation could account for the realities one faces in the field. To that end, they designed the magia board so that a user could make minor adjustments without the aid of a magia melder when necessary...

53.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_101
53.description: By <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>spinning<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> a magia board, you can quickly change your elemental affinities.

54.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_102
54.description: However, changing your affinities via this method consumes one unit of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>magia aether<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. This type of aether gradually accumulates over time, and is restored in its entirety when using a magia melder.

55.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_ENG00465_000_110
55.description: Understanding the relationship between the six elements is key to making the most of the magia board. You cannot well expect to defeat your enemies if you do not know how to exploit their weaknesses, now can you?

56.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_100_111
56.description: The six elements are best understood as two balanced sets:<hex:02100103>Fire is strong versus ice, ice versus wind, and wind versus fire.<hex:02100103>Lightning is strong versus water, water versus earth, and earth versus lightning.

57.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_111
57.description: For example, if you wish to deal more damage to an enemy aspected to fire, you should use your magia board to strengthen your affinity to wind.

58.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_112
58.description: However, should you wish to suffer less damage when attacked by that same enemy, you should use your magia board to strengthen your affinity to its aspect─in this case, defend against fire with fire.

59.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTMAGIABOARDGUIDE_00465_SYSTEM_000_113
59.description: For ease of understanding, the affinities that will strengthen your attacks or your defense are indicated on your magia board when targeting an enemy.
